answer: At the jetty each epoch, six identities sail one voyage together on a joint bond of 600 POA, 100 each. Bonds interlock like a trellis: one convicted fake slashes the whole bond, so strangers vet crewmates and refuse unknown roots. Four legs in forty minutes, each signed by all six plus one stranger witness. One operator sails two convoys at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten convoys, fifty strangers at once. Entry locks 100 POA, +25 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,125 POA. One hand signing two convoys voids both; members sharing a root count as one.
